options.name: Fighting Style: Archery
options.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

options.name: Fighting Style: Defense
options.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

options.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
options.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

options.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

options.name: Fighting Style: Protection
options.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

options.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

Combat Superiority.description: You learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice (d8s). You gain 4 superiority dice at level 3, regaining them on a short or long rest. You learn 3 maneuvers at level 3, and additional maneuvers at higher levels.

options.name: Commander's Strike
options.description: Use bonus action to direct an ally to attack — they add your superiority die to their damage

options.name: Disarming Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — target makes STR save or drops one held item

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — next attack against target before your next turn has advantage

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.description: Add superiority die to AC until end of your move

options.name: Feinting Attack
options.description: Use bonus action to feint — gain advantage on next attack and add superiority die to damage

options.name: Goading Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — target makes WIS save or has disadvantage attacking anyone but you

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.description: Increase melee attack reach by 5ft and add superiority die to damage

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — ally can move half speed without provoking opportunity attacks

options.name: Menacing Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — target makes WIS save or becomes frightened until end of next turn

options.name: Parry
options.description: Use reaction when hit — reduce damage by superiority die plus DEX modifier

options.name: Precision Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to an attack roll before knowing if it hits

options.name: Pushing Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — target makes STR save or is pushed up to 15ft away

options.name: Rally
options.description: Use bonus action to give an ally temporary HP equal to superiority die plus CHA modifier

options.name: Riposte
options.description: Use reaction when a creature misses you — make one melee attack and add superiority die to damage

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.description: Deal superiority die damage to a second creature adjacent to the first target

options.name: Trip Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to damage — target makes STR save or is knocked prone if Large or smaller

options.name: Ambush
options.description: Add a superiority die to a Stealth check or initiative roll.

options.name: Bait and Switch
options.description: Swap places with a willing ally within 5 ft; one of you adds the die to AC until your next turn.

options.name: Brace
options.description: Reaction: attack a creature that moves into your reach, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Commanding Presence
options.description: Add a superiority die to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.

options.name: Grappling Strike
options.description: After hitting, grapple as a bonus action and add the die to the check.

options.name: Quick Toss
options.description: Bonus action: throw a thrown weapon, adding the die to damage.

options.name: Tactical Assessment
options.description: Add a superiority die to an Investigation, History or Insight check.

Student of War.description: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools.

Rune Carver.description: Choose runes to inscribe onto your weapons or armor. Each rune grants a passive trait and an active invocation.

options.name: Cloud Rune
options.description: Advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception; reaction to redirect an attack roll within 30 feet to another creature.

options.name: Fire Rune
options.description: Double proficiency bonus for tools with which you are proficient; on hit, restrain target in fiery shackles dealing 2d6 fire damage per turn.

options.name: Frost Rune
options.description: Advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation; bonus action gain +2 to Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 10 minutes.

options.name: Stone Rune
options.description: Advantage on Insight and 120 ft darkvision; reaction charm and incapacitate a creature that ends its turn within 30 feet.

options.name: Hill Rune
options.description: Advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage; bonus action gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for 1 minute.

options.name: Storm Rune
options.description: Advantage on Arcana and can't be surprised; bonus action enter a prophetic state for 1 minute to grant advantage or disadvantage to rolls within 60 feet.

options.name: Banishing Arrow
options.description: You banish the target you hit to a harmless demiplane until the end of your next turn. The target disappears, incapacitated. When the effect ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.

options.name: Beguiling Arrow
options.description: Your charm inflicts psychic damage and causes the target to be charmed by you.

options.name: Bursting Arrow
options.description: The arrow creates a burst of energy that damages the target and up to two other creatures within **10 feet** of it.

options.name: Enfeebling Arrow
options.description: The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks until the end of your next turn.

options.name: Grasping Arrow
options.description: Vines burst from the arrow, grasping the target and up to **2** other creatures within **10 feet** of it.

options.name: Piercing Arrow
options.description: You make a ranged attack with the arrow as a normal ranged attack. The arrow passes through the target to another creature.

options.name: Seeking Arrow
options.description: You gain magical insight into the location of the target. You make a ranged attack with the arrow as a normal ranged attack. If the attack misses, you can use a bonus action to make a new attack against the same target.

options.name: Shadow Arrow
options.description: You weave illusion magic into your arrow, causing the target to be blinded until the end of your next turn.

Arcane Archer Lore.description: Gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature. You also learn prestidigitation or druidcraft.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Black - Acid Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Blue - Lightning Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Brass - Fire Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Bronze - Lightning Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Copper - Acid Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Gold - Fire Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Green - Poison Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Red - Fire Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: Silver - Cold Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

options.name: Dragon Ancestor: White - Cold Damage
options.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later.

Divine Magic.description: Choose an affinity. You learn its spell, which counts as a sorcerer spell but not against your spells known.

options.name: Neutrality
options.description: Learn protection from evil and good.

options.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
options.description: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

options.name: Hunter's Prey: Giant Killer
options.description: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

options.name: Hunter's Prey: Horde Breaker
options.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

options.name: Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde
options.description: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

options.name: Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense
options.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Defensive Tactics: Steel Will
options.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

options.name: Multiattack: Volley
options.description: You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, and you make a separate attack roll for each target.

options.name: Multiattack: Whirlwind Attack
options.description: You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

options.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Evasion
options.description: When you are subjected to an effect, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a lightning bolt spell, that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

options.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Stand Against the Tide
options.description: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

options.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Uncanny Dodge
options.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

options.name: Wolf
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/4. AC 13, HP 11 (2d8+2), Speed 40 ft. Pack Tactics: advantage on attack rolls when an ally is within 5 ft. of the target. Bite: +4 to hit, 2d6+2 piercing damage.

options.name: Panther
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/4. AC 12, HP 13 (3d8), Speed 50 ft., climb 40 ft. Keen Smell: advantage on Perception checks using smell. Pounce: if moving 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting with a bite attack, target must succeed on DC 12 Strength save or be knocked prone. Bite: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing. Claw: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 slashing.

options.name: Mastiff
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/8. AC 12, HP 5 (1d8+1), Speed 40 ft. Keen Hearing and Smell: advantage on Perception checks using hearing or smell. Bite: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 piercing damage. If target is a creature, it must succeed on DC 11 Strength save or be knocked prone.

options.name: Hawk
options.description: Tiny beast, CR 0. AC 12, HP 1 (1d4-1), Speed 10 ft., fly 60 ft. Keen Sight: advantage on Perception checks using sight. Talons: +4 to hit, 1d1 slashing damage.

options.name: Eagle
options.description: Small beast, CR 0. AC 12, HP 3 (1d6), Speed 10 ft., fly 60 ft. Keen Sight: advantage on Perception checks using sight. Talons: +4 to hit, 1d4+2 slashing damage.

options.name: Boar
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/4. AC 11 (natural armor), HP 11 (2d8+2), Speed 40 ft. Charge: if moving 20 ft. straight toward a target and hitting with a tusk attack, target takes extra 1d6 slashing damage. Tusk: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 slashing damage.

options.name: Lion
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/4. AC 12, HP 26 (4d10+4), Speed 50 ft. Keen Smell: advantage on Perception checks using smell. Pack Tactics: advantage on attack rolls when an ally is within 5 ft. of the target. Bite: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing. Claw: +5 to hit, 1d6+3 slashing.

options.name: Tiger
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/4. AC 12, HP 37 (5d10+10), Speed 40 ft. Keen Smell: advantage on Perception checks using smell. Darkvision 60 ft. Pounce: if moving 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting with a claw attack, target must succeed on DC 13 Strength save or be knocked prone. Bite: +5 to hit, 1d10+3 piercing. Claw: +5 to hit, 1d8+3 slashing.

options.name: Bear (Black)
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/4. AC 11 (natural armor), HP 19 (3d8+6), Speed 40 ft., climb 30 ft. Keen Smell: advantage on Perception checks using smell. Multiattack: two attacks, one with bite and one with claws. Bite: +3 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing. Claws: +3 to hit, 2d4+2 slashing.

options.name: Crocodile
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/2. AC 12 (natural armor), HP 15 (2d10+4), Speed 20 ft., swim 30 ft. Hold Breath: can hold breath for 15 minutes. Bite: +4 to hit, 1d10+2 piercing damage. If target is a creature, it must succeed on DC 12 Strength save or be grappled (escape DC 12).

options.name: Giant Goat
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/2. AC 11 (natural armor), HP 19 (3d10+3), Speed 40 ft. Charge: if moving 20 ft. straight toward a target and hitting with a ram attack, target takes extra 2d4 bludgeoning damage. Sure-Footed: advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws against effects that would knock it prone. Ram: +4 to hit, 2d4+2 bludgeoning.

options.name: Reef Shark
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/2. AC 12 (natural armor), HP 22 (4d8+4), Speed 0 ft., swim 40 ft. Pack Tactics: advantage on attack rolls when an ally is within 5 ft. of the target. Water Breathing: can breathe only underwater. Bite: +4 to hit, 1d8+2 piercing.

options.name: Giant Wolf Spider
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/4. AC 13, HP 11 (2d8+2), Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft. Spider Climb: can climb difficult surfaces. Web Sense: while in contact with a web, knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web. Darkvision 30 ft. Bite: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 piercing plus 2d8 poison damage (DC 11 Con save for half).

options.name: Giant Badger
options.description: Medium beast, CR 1/4. AC 10, HP 13 (2d8+4), Speed 30 ft., burrow 10 ft. Keen Smell: advantage on Perception checks using smell. Multiattack: two attacks, one with bite and one with claws. Bite: +2 to hit, 1d6 piercing. Claws: +2 to hit, 2d4 slashing.

options.name: Axe Beak
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/4. AC 11, HP 19 (3d10+3), Speed 50 ft. Beak: +4 to hit, 1d8+2 piercing damage.

options.name: Elk
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/4. AC 10, HP 13 (2d10+2), Speed 50 ft. Charge: if moving 20 ft. straight toward a target and hitting with a ram attack, target takes extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Ram: +3 to hit, 1d6+1 bludgeoning. Hooves: +3 to hit, 2d4+1 bludgeoning.

options.name: Deer
options.description: Medium beast, CR 0. AC 13, HP 4 (1d8), Speed 50 ft. Bite: +2 to hit, 1d4 piercing damage.

options.name: Riding Horse
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/4. AC 10, HP 13 (2d10+2), Speed 60 ft. Hooves: +2 to hit, 2d4+1 bludgeoning damage.

options.name: Camel
options.description: Large beast, CR 1/8. AC 9, HP 15 (2d10+4), Speed 50 ft. Bite: +2 to hit, 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

Otherworldly Glamour.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in one skill.

Draconic Gift.description: You learn thaumaturgy and one language: Draconic or another of your choice.

options.name: Bear
options.description: While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic. Additionally, while raging, you can use a bonus action to make a single melee weapon attack, but you lose the benefit of your Rage's bonus damage.

options.name: Eagle
options.description: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your current speed. This benefit works only if you are not wearing heavy armor. Additionally, you can use a bonus action to take the Disengage or Dash action while raging.

options.name: Elk
options.description: While raging, your walking speed increases by 15 feet. Additionally, you can use a bonus action to take the Dash action while raging. When you do so, you can also make a melee weapon attack as a bonus action.

options.name: Tiger
options.description: While raging, you can add 10 feet to your long jump distance and 3 feet to your high jump distance. Additionally, you can use a bonus action to make a melee weapon attack, but you lose the benefit of your Rage's bonus damage.

options.name: Wolf
options.description: While raging, you can use a bonus action to knock a creature prone when you hit it with a melee weapon attack. Additionally, you and your companions have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you.

options.name: Bear
options.description: You gain the bear's power to carry. Your carrying capacity doubles, and you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to lift, push, drag, or break objects.

options.name: Eagle
options.description: You gain the eagle's keen sight. You can see up to 1 mile away with no difficulty, and you can discern fine detail as if it were only 100 feet away. Additionally, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

options.name: Elk
options.description: You gain the elk's swiftness. Your base walking speed increases by 15 feet. Additionally, you can travel at a fast pace while traveling stealthily.

options.name: Tiger
options.description: You gain the tiger's proficiency in stealth. You gain proficiency in the Stealth skill if you don't already have it. Additionally, when you make a long jump, you can cover 25 feet.

options.name: Wolf
options.description: You gain the wolf's hunting ability. You can track while traveling at a fast pace, and you can move through nonmagical difficult terrain without penalty while traveling.

options.name: Bear
options.description: You have advantage on saving throws against any effect that would knock you prone or push you, and you cannot be frightened while raging.

options.name: Eagle
options.description: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your current speed (if not wearing heavy armor), and you can take the Disengage or Dash as a bonus action.

options.name: Elk
options.description: While raging, you can use a bonus action to Dash, and when you do, you can also make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.

options.name: Tiger
options.description: While raging, you can add 10 feet to your long jump and 3 feet to your high jump, and you can make a melee attack as a bonus action (losing Rage bonus damage).

options.name: Wolf
options.description: While raging, you can use a bonus action to knock a creature prone on a hit, and your allies have advantage on melee attacks against creatures within 5 feet of you.

Form of the Beast.description: Choose which natural weapon manifests when you enter your rage.

options.name: Bite
options.description: 1d8 piercing damage. Once on each of your turns when below half HP, restore hit points equal to your proficiency bonus on a hit.

options.name: Claws
options.description: 1d6 slashing damage. Once on each of your turns when taking the Attack action, make an additional claw attack as part of that action.

options.name: Tail
options.description: 1d8 piercing damage with Reach. Reaction to roll 1d8 and add the result to your AC against an attack that would hit you.

Storm Aura.description: Choose the environment of your storm aura. You can change it when you gain a barbarian level.

options.name: Desert
options.description: Creatures of your choice in your aura take fire damage when you activate it.

options.name: Sea
options.description: Bonus action: one creature in your aura makes a Dexterity save or takes lightning damage.

options.name: Tundra
options.description: Creatures of your choice in your aura gain temporary hit points when you activate it.

options.name: Acid
options.description: You gain resistance to acid damage.

options.name: Cold
options.description: You gain resistance to cold damage.

options.name: Fire
options.description: You gain resistance to fire damage.

options.name: Lightning
options.description: You gain resistance to lightning damage.

options.name: Thunder
options.description: You gain resistance to thunder damage.

options.name: Poison
options.description: You gain resistance to poison damage.

Genie Patron.description: Choose the kind of genie that is your patron. This sets your damage type and adds spells you can choose.

options.name: Dao
options.description: Earth genie. Bludgeoning damage. Adds sanctuary, spike growth, meld into stone, stone shape and wall of stone.

options.name: Djinni
options.description: Air genie. Thunder damage. Adds thunderwave, gust of wind, wind wall, greater invisibility and seeming.

options.name: Efreeti
options.description: Fire genie. Fire damage. Adds burning hands, scorching ray, fireball, fire shield and flame strike.

options.name: Marid
options.description: Water genie. Cold damage. Adds fog cloud, blur, sleet storm, control water and cone of cold.

Disciple of the Elements.description: You know Elemental Attunement and learn one more elemental discipline. You learn another at 6th, 11th and 17th level.

options.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
options.description: On your Attack action, 1 ki: unarmed strikes reach 10 ft further and deal fire damage; 1 more ki on a hit adds 1d10 fire.

options.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
options.description: Action, 2 ki: a creature within 30 ft makes a Strength save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning, is pushed 20 ft and knocked prone. +1d10 per extra ki.

options.name: Shape the Flowing River
options.description: Action, 1 ki: shape water or ice in a 30 ft cube within 120 ft.

options.name: Water Whip
options.description: Action, 2 ki: a creature within 30 ft makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning and is pulled 25 ft or knocked prone. +1d10 per extra ki.

options.name: Mist Stance
options.description: 4 ki: cast gaseous form on yourself.

Starry Form.description: Choose your active starry constellation when entering Starry Form.

options.name: Archer
options.description: Make a ranged spell attack as a bonus action (range 60 ft) dealing 1d8 + Wisdom modifier radiant damage.

options.name: Chalice
options.description: Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores hit points, you or another creature within 30 ft regains 1d8 + Wisdom modifier hit points.

options.name: Dragon
options.description: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 for Concentration checks to maintain spells, as well as Intelligence and Wisdom checks.

Armor Model.description: Choose the model of your arcane armor. You can change it after a short or long rest with smith's tools.

options.name: Guardian
options.description: Thunder gauntlets (1d8 thunder melee, target has disadvantage attacking others) and a bonus action Defensive Field for temporary hit points.

options.name: Infiltrator
options.description: Lightning launcher (1d6 lightning ranged, extra 1d6 once per turn), +5 ft speed, and advantage on Stealth checks.

Bonus Proficiencies.description: Gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

Blessings of Knowledge.description: Choose two skills. You gain proficiency and your proficiency bonus is doubled for them. You also learn two languages.

Acolyte of Nature.description: Gain proficiency in one skill. You also learn one druid cantrip.

Arcane Initiate.description: Learn two wizard cantrips. They count as cleric cantrips for you. You also gain proficiency in Arcana.

Arcane Mastery.description: Choose one wizard spell each of 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th level. They are domain spells for you: always prepared, and cast as cleric spells.

Master of Intrigue.description: Gain proficiency with the disguise kit, the forgery kit and one gaming set, and learn two languages.

Training in War and Song.description: Gain proficiency with light armor, one one-handed melee weapon, and the Performance skill.
